acceptance_criterion: `go build` produces a `frank` binary with no CGO
All four verbs are routed; unimplemented ones exit with the usage/config code
Global flags parse: `--config`, `--output`, `--json`, `--verbose`, `--dry-run`, `--rate`, `--confirm-send`, `--redact`
CI runs vet and `go test -race` on push, and is green
No third-party dependencies added
A hand-constructed Transcript renders to both formats
Reply parsing covers multiline continuations and enhanced status codes
Every event carries both a monotonic and a wall-clock stamp, and they are monotonic in order
`--redact` accepts a repeatable RE2 pattern and masks matches in both renderings
The redaction code path is exercised by a test even when no pattern is supplied
The in-memory Transcript is unchanged by rendering
Accepts or rejects at any Phase, with a caller-supplied code, enhanced status and text
Advertises a caller-supplied extension list in its EHLO response
Offers or refuses STARTTLS on demand, with a self-signed certificate for the TLS case
Rejects a specific Identity Triple and accepts the rest
Can emit a Deferral first and an Acceptance on a later connection, so greylisting is testable
Runs in-process on an ephemeral port and needs no fixtures on disk
`--envelope-from`, `--helo` and `--header-from` are independent and any may differ from any other
A test asserts all three mismatched values appear verbatim in the Transcript at the correct Phases
EHLO falls back to HELO and the fallback is recorded
Exactly one Recipient per Probe, so every Phase has exactly one Outcome
Correct dot-stuffing and CRLF-dot-CRLF termination, covered by a test with a body line starting in a dot
The reply to the DATA verb and the reply to the terminating dot are recorded as separate Phases
Per-Phase timings are populated and monotonic
A clean QUIT on every exit path, including error paths
Exit codes are asserted by tests
`require` aborts when STARTTLS is unavailable, `prefer` continues in plaintext, `none` never offers it
The chain, negotiated version and cipher are recorded identically whether verification passes or fails
A Probe against a self-signed certificate completes with `--tls-verify=false` and records the failure as a finding
The same Probe aborts with `--tls-verify=true`, and the chain is still in the Transcript
Session resumption is disabled, with a test proving the certificate is captured on every connection
The server name used for verification is set explicitly and recorded
Without `--confirm-send`, a run walks to RCPT TO and stops, transmitting no Probe Message
`--confirm-send` requires a Recipient and the Recipient appears in the Transcript
`--confirm-send` together with `--dry-run` is a usage error
A run needing confirmation with no TTY errors before the first dial, proven by a test
The rate limiter defaults to 6 per minute and is asserted by a timing test
An attempt to raise the rate above the default is refused
Repeated Deferrals back off exponentially and abort past a threshold
An interface covering TXT, A/AAAA, MX, PTR and NS that the standard resolver satisfies
A fixture resolver seeded from a table, with no network access
Multi-string TXT records arrive as a single concatenated string
Non-existent name and no-record-of-this-type are distinguishable to callers
The real resolver is forced to the pure-Go implementation, with no CGO
A test proves the suite makes no outbound DNS query
Table-driven tests over zone fixtures cover nested includes, redirect, and each Verdict class
The Matched Mechanism is reported correctly for each case
Over-limit records are detected and reported as a finding
Addresses are normalised before matching, with a test for the IPv4-mapped case
Addresses carrying a zone are rejected rather than silently mismatched
Each `ip4` fixture case has an `ip6` twin
Without `--client-ip`, `auth` renders the tree and reports the Verdict as not evaluated
`auth` opens no TCP connection, proven by a test
Key records are parsed for version, key type, the public key and flags
Revoked, empty and test-mode keys are reported as faults
Discovery finds a seeded selector among decoys in the fixtures
`--selector` is repeatable and adds to the built-in list
The effective list probed appears in both renderings
Discovery query volume is bounded, and the bound is stated in the output
Policy, subdomain policy, both alignment modes, sampling rate and the reporting addresses are parsed
Alignment is computed for both SPF and DKIM, in relaxed and strict modes
Fixtures cover strict versus relaxed, subdomain policy, and a missing record resolving to none
The sampling rate is reported and never applied, with a test proving repeated runs agree
A null Envelope Sender moves the SPF subject to the HELO Identity, and the Verdict names which subject it evaluated
PLAIN and LOGIN both work against the test double
Authentication over a non-TLS connection is refused, with a test
Credentials are read from the environment and the config file, and never from a flag
A test asserts the credential appears in neither rendering, in either mechanism
The advertised mechanism list is recorded, and an unsupported-mechanism case reports clearly
Against a test double rejecting one specific Triple, that Cell resolves Rejected and all others Accepted
A fresh connection per Cell, asserted by counting connections at the test double
A greylisting host produces an Inconclusive Cell, and a retry that succeeds resolves it to Accepted
An aborted sweep leaves Unrun Cells that render distinctly from Inconclusive ones
`--rate` is honoured and cannot be raised above the default
The matrix exits 1 if any Cell is Rejected, otherwise 4 if any is Inconclusive or Unrun, otherwise 0
Runs clean under the race detector
Golden-file tests cover alignment failure, over-limit SPF, TLS refusal and greylisting
Observed Outcomes and computed Verdicts are distinguishable in the output
An ambiguous case says so and names the disambiguating Probe
A matrix Transcript produces a run-level Diagnosis plus a per-Cell line
Unreadable input exits with the usage code
No Diagnosis ever claims a message was delivered
One report combines Transcript, Verdicts, matrix and Diagnosis in both formats
Both renderings are always written to the output directory, defaulting to a timestamped one
The JSON flag changes only what standard output carries
A mistyped config key is an error naming the key
A key set to zero is distinguishable from an absent key, with tests for the rate and verification cases
Explicit flags beat config values
An end-to-end run against the test double yields a report that needs no source reading, and exit codes are asserted
